Description

Demo satellites for end-to-end solutions for global IoT services.

Connecta T1.2 is a test platform in our roadmap toward our direct-to-satellite IoT connectivity solution. It has a software-defined radio based IoT payload and we will test the proprietary IoT waveform design.
